belay.2: The belay is on Smoke Break Ledge, reached by an easy left-facing corner after the lunge to the ledge.

belay.5: The belay is at the bolts set farther left, beyond the rappel anchors you pass near the end of the pitch.
belay.7: The belay is at a bolted anchor just under the summit, with a short scramble remaining to the top.

belay.P2: The belay is at the anchor reached just after the last 5.6 move above the flared seam.
belay.P4: The belay is at the top of the ramp that climbs up and left, directly below the obvious double corner.
